            .then(result => {

        // --- SYMBOL INSERTION ---
        function insertAtCursor(myValue) {
            const myField = document.getElementById('sourceCode');
            if (document.selection) {
                myField.focus();
                sel = document.selection.createRange();
                sel.text = myValue;
            } else if (myField.selectionStart || myField.selectionStart == '0') {
                var startPos = myField.selectionStart;
                var endPos = myField.selectionEnd;
                myField.value = myField.value.substring(0, startPos) + myValue + myField.value.substring(endPos, myField.value.length);
                myField.focus();
                myField.selectionStart = startPos + myValue.length;
                myField.selectionEnd = startPos + myValue.length;
            } else {
                myField.value += myValue;
            }
            autoSave();
        }

        function checkFollowStatus(targetUid, btnId) {

            db.collection('users').doc(currentUser.uid).get().then(doc => {

        function updateFollowBtnUI(btnId, isFollowing) {
            const btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
            if(isFollowing) {
                btn.innerText = "Following";
                btn.classList.add('following');
            } else {
                btn.innerText = "Follow";
                btn.classList.remove('following');

        function toggleFollowFromDetail() { handleFollowToggle(currentViewingDevId, 'dFollowBtn'); }

        function handleFollowToggle(targetUid, btnId) {
            if(!targetUid || targetUid === currentUser.uid) return;
            const btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
            const isFollowing = btn.classList.contains('following');
            const myRef = db.collection('users').doc(currentUser.uid);
            const targetRef = db.collection('users').doc(targetUid);
            if(isFollowing) {
                myRef.update({ following: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.arrayRemove(targetUid) });
                targetRef.update({ followers: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.arrayRemove(currentUser.uid) });
                updateFollowBtnUI(btnId, false);
                // Optimistic UI update for numbers if on profile page
                if(btnId === 'publicFollowBtn') {
                    const el = document.getElementById('pubDevFollowers');
                    el.innerText = Math.max(0, parseInt(el.innerText) - 1);

            } else {
                myRef.update({ following: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.arrayUnion(targetUid) });
                targetRef.update({ followers: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.arrayUnion(currentUser.uid) });
                updateFollowBtnUI(btnId, true);
                if(btnId === 'publicFollowBtn') {
                    const el = document.getElementById('pubDevFollowers');
                    el.innerText = parseInt(el.innerText) + 1;
                }
            }
        }
